big_case.notes: End-stage capital stay application on recurring Florida clemency-discretion and clemency-records claims that the Court had turned away in other Florida warrant cases within the preceding weeks; denied with the linked certiorari petition in a one-sentence unsigned order, no writing or noted dissent, no amicus participation. The stakes for the applicant are total, but the doctrinal and public significance beyond the execution itself is low.

leakage.notes: Forward cell. Every logged call is timestamped 17-18 Nov 2026, before the 19 Nov resolution; the log and prose show no retrieved document dated on or after resolution, no disposing order, and no read under data/qp-topics/. All ten calls are captured. The only dated retrieval is the corpus row for the linked petition 26-6154 (document date 2026-11-14, pre-resolution; the candidate reports it showed no distribution yet). It discloses printing the prior-day case summary summaries/2026-11-16.md from a file listing; that file predates the resolution and restates the docket. No CourtListener or web lookup.
